prompt: An AI wrote a sliding-window rate-limit check: allow a request if fewer than `limit` timestamps fall within the last `windowMs` (`now - t < windowMs`). It lets one extra request through. Fix `allow`.

An AI wrote a webhook check that hashes only the body, so anyone can forge it. Fix `verify_signature`: the header is `sha256=` + the hex HMAC-SHA256 of `body` keyed with `secret`. Compare with `hmac.compare_digest`.

coding.starterCode:
import hashlib

def verify_signature(secret, body, signature):
    digest = hashlib.sha256(body.encode()).hexdigest()
    return signature == "sha256=" + digest
